[[File:Tech Console.png|thumb]]
The '''Tech Console''' is a new defense Module introduced in November.

== Description ==
''A seemingly-innocuous programming interface capable of mechanical annihilation in the hands of Tech Bots.''

== Abilities ==
===Basic Abilities===
*Enhanced [[Repair]]
*Enhanced Power Gain
*Enhanced [[Shock]]

=== Abilities ===
*''Passive:''
**The strength of Repair Buffs is increased by 30~67% and further increased by 30~67% for every 25% missing health.
**The strength of Power Gain Buffs is increased by 30~67% and further increased by 30~67% for every 25% missing health.
**The duration and damage of Shock Debuffs are increased by 50~112% and further increased by 50~112% for every 25% missing health.
*''When activating a Power Gain or Repair Buff:'' Activates Tech Shielding, capping the maximum damage of an opponent’s attack to 2% of the defender’s max Health.

===Signature Ability===
'''Divert Shields'''

When activating a Power Gain or  Repair Buff: Activates Tech Shielding (when filling a Power Bar.) Whenever activating Tech Shielding, if any Shields are active, it also activates an Attack Buff. (increasing Attack Rating by 40% for 4~10 seconds.)

== Strategy ==
Most Tech Bots can benefit from one of the three passive buffs this Mod provides. [[Ratchet]] and [[Sideswipe]] are good matches, as these bots have powerful healing and power gaining abilities that will be super-charged while under the effects of this module. Those with strong shock abilities, the most obvious being [[Soundwave]], [[Shockwave]] and [[Scorponok]] will benefit from the Console's enhanced shock abilities. Others with powerful shields such as [[Rhinox]] or [[Wheeljack]] will gain an attack buff when their shields are active.
* Wheeljack - This bot already has strong healing with his special 3 and at rank five he will repair 16.7% - 33.2%  health which will make it so he will be the longest standing bot and with the divert shields and enhanced shock buffs he will be outputting massive amounts of damage.

== Obtainment ==
* the 3~4 Star Mod can be found in the Exclusive Mod Crystal.

</gallery>

==Notes==
*Game files in the Beta version had something called the '''Tech Awakening Stone'''.
